tissue_ordering: Python Unicode code-point ascending; zero-based index
inner_policy: Training-only tissue-stratified StratifiedGroupKFold with 3 folds and the resolved tissue-specific seed; same three-fold tuning policy as fixed-eight repeated evaluation
expected_inner_splitter_warning_policy: Preflight may warn when an outer-training tissue has only one or two groups. Preserve the three grouped folds; every sample must still occur in exactly one validation fold and no group may cross inner train/validation. Record warning text/count and disclose the rare-tissue tuning limitation; do not drop tissues or redesign folds based on scores.
split_policy: For each frozen tissue, hold out all its available samples/groups for a drug; train on the other 22 tissues. Reuse the same tissue outer split across every drug/model arm. Inner folds partition only that drug's outer-training samples.
primary_contrast: response_association_pair_full minus expression_strong Spearman in each held-out tissue
primary_tissue_set: Frozen 10 tissues with at least 20 groups per drug; equal tissue weights within drug
strict_missing_policy: Any undefined primary tissue contrast makes that drug's 10-tissue mean NA. Any undefined drug mean makes the equal-eight-drug macro NA. Preserve defined-cell counts; never nanmean the strict estimand.
secondary_outputs: Per-drug × tissue × model metrics for all 23 held-out tissues
Paired RMSE improvement versus same-policy unseen-tissue global mean
Concatenated LOTO OOF Spearman labelled cross-tissue calibration-sensitive
inferential_status: Sensitivity analysis only; no confirmatory family and no confidence intervals

resources.failure_policy: Preserve every completed and failed task, stop on the first failed fit task, and only resume this exact frozen version; never omit a task based on score.

execution_code_change: Add the two Windows system commit-memory fields returned by process_tree_memory() to the controller resource CSV schema; no model, split, data, or statistic changes.
